adjusted_ingredient_amounts: 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh or frozen mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrots, cauliflower, zucchini)
11 ounces diced tomatoes with Italian herbs
6 tablespoons shredded part-skim Mozzarella cheese or Parmesan cheese
preparation_steps: Cook 6 ounces pasta as directed on the package.
When pasta is done, add 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh or frozen mixed vegetables. Cook 2 more minutes for fresh vegetables or 1 minute for frozen. Turn off heat. Drain pasta and vegetables carefully.
Put pot back on stove over medium-low heat. Add 10.9 ounces diced tomatoes with their juices to the pot. Stir well. Heat 1-2 minutes.
Remove from heat. Split pasta and vegetables between plates or bowls. Top each with 2 tablespoons cheese. Serve right away.

adjusted_ingredient_amounts: 5 to 6 ounces refrigerated pizza crust dough
preparation_steps: Place an oven rack in the middle of the oven. Preheat oven to 350°F.
Spray a skillet with nonstick cooking spray and heat over medium heat.
Add 1 7/8 cups sliced mushrooms and 3/16 cup chopped onion and sauté until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add 3 cups chopped Swiss chard and 3/4 tablespoon water. Continue cooking until Swiss chard becomes tender, about 8 to 10 minutes (add more water if needed).
Add 3/8 teaspoon garlic powder, 3/16 teaspoon ground black pepper, and 3/16 teaspoon salt.
Remove skillet from heat and stir in 3/4 tablespoon grated Parmesan cheese. Set aside to cool.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out 5 to 6 ounces pizza dough into a 10 x 14-inch rectangle.
Spread cooled Swiss chard mixture and 3/8 cup shredded Mozzarella cheese on top of dough, leaving about 1 inch around edges.
Starting from the long side, roll up the crust to make one large loaf.
Pinch along the seam to seal and fold ends under the loaf.
Place loaf on a baking sheet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.
Bake for 40 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Cut into slices and serve with 9/16 cup warmed marinara sauce.
